components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, with a clear green fill and compact hit area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--bamboo); color: var(--ink-on-accent); padding: 11px 17px; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.3 "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 0.16s, color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s, box-shadow 0.16s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bamboo-hover); box-shadow: 0 3px 9px #00000033; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bamboo); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Subtle Button
components.description: Secondary action on a transparent surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-subtle { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); padding: 11px 17px; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius: 5px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.3 "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 0.16s, color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s, box-shadow 0.16s; } .ds-btn-subtle:hover { background: var(--raised); border-color: var(--bamboo-hover); } .ds-btn-subtle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bamboo); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Research Search Field
components.description: Compact search field within the research index.
components.css: .ds-search { display: block; background: var(--surface); padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 0.75rem "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--bamboo); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: Route link with understated text and bamboo active indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding-top: 2px; font: 400 0.875rem "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link-active { border-bottom-color: var(--bamboo); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bamboo); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Analysis Card
components.description: Surface for portfolio performance and risk content.
components.css: .ds-analysis-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 24px 27px 0; color: var(--ink); font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-analysis-card h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 500 1.3125rem/1.3 "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-analysis-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: PandaSet is a browser-based portfolio workspace for individual investors. Its warm-neutral foundation supports dense analysis; panda ink sets hierarchy, while bamboo green marks primary actions and active states. Preserve the distinction between illustrative sample data, modeled results, and hypothetical scenarios.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, low-glare neutrals with strong ink contrast.
Bamboo green is the single primary accent.
Semantic gains, losses, warnings, and comparisons remain distinct.
dos: Do use bamboo green for primary actions, focus, active states, and the lead performance series.
Do keep negative, positive, warning, and comparison cues distinct from one another.
Do preserve visible sample-data and modeled-result labels.
donts: Don't return page backgrounds or card surfaces to the former dark theme.
Don't use the accent as a substitute for semantic gain or loss colors.
Don't imply sample portfolio values are live market or brokerage data.
